About

Engineering is the constant.

I am pursuing a Bachelor of Engineering in Mechatronics Engineering at Kumaraguru College of Technology. My interests include embedded systems, robotics, industrial automation, control systems, product development, and intelligent engineering solutions.

  • 01

    Embedded systems

    I work with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32, STM32, sensors, and IoT to turn ideas into practical systems.

  • 02

    Robotics

    I explore robotics and automation through hands-on engineering, simulation, and practical system development.

  • 03

    Industrial automation

    I apply industrial automation, control systems, and process simulation to understand efficient engineering workflows.

  • 04

    Practical problem solving

    I connect software, electronics, mechanics, and automation to create useful solutions grounded in real-world constraints.
